help.short: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.

A queue name must be unique within a storage account and must be between 3 and 63 characters.The name must comprise of lowercase alphanumeric and dash(-) characters only, it should begin and end with an alphanumeric character and it cannot have two consecutive dash(-) characters.

confirmation: Are you sure you want to perform this operation?
description: Delete the queue with the specified queue name, under the specified account if it exists.

operations.description: Deletes the queue with the specified queue name, under the specified account if it exists.
